testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, modals, language toggle, buy button, cart items, stripe checkout inputs) MUST have unique data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts link for 'Cinzel', 'Tajawal', 'Cairo', and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' in index.html or top of index.css.
Ensure global HTML element updates `dir='rtl'` when language is switched to Arabic, and `dir='ltr'` when English.
Use Framer Motion for line-by-line kinetic hero entrance, scroll reveals, modal popovers, and cart drawer sliding.
Implement high-contrast gold buttons (#D4AF37 with dark hover state) so text and prices are easily readable.
Build a complete single-page store experience plus seamless full-screen Checkout / Download Success view or drawer.
Ensure Stripe checkout is gracefully MOCKED with interactive realistic fields and instant processing feedback.
Include direct WhatsApp order link with pre-filled message support for GCC buyers.
Every key interactive element must include explicit data-testid attributes.
